findings.description: From about 00:04.5 the hair begins streaming strongly backward. By 00:05.5 to 00:09.75 it is whipping as hard as it would in a moving car or a strong gust. In the first 4 seconds it was nearly still. The car appears parked, with no road blur and only camera-driven parallax. The desert shrubs and grass show no wind movement at any point. So a sudden, sustained strong-wind effect appears with no visible cause, and it is out of proportion to the calm environment.
